task: Investigated a live owner-reported bug (segment highlighting showed duplicate/cross-attributed progress across two concurrently-rendering XTTS segments once ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION defaulted on). Traced the entire orchestrator-side dispatch chain (DB query -> build_chunk_groups -> ChapterSynthesisTask fan-out -> SegmentSynthesisTask -> _SyntheticSegmentTask -> _dispatch_segment -> bridge_remote/tts_client) and confirmed every layer is provably isolated per-call. Found and fixed one genuine, previously-unreachable concurrency hazard: unsynchronized concurrent writes to the shared TTS Server process stderr from multiple synthesis request threads.

plugins/tts_xtts/plugin/server/engine.py.summary: Added module-level _STDERR_WRITE_LOCK and _emit_stderr_atomic(line) which writes the pre-joined 'line + newline' as a single locked sys.stderr.write() call. Replaced all three print(..., file=sys.stderr, flush=True) call sites in parse_output (normalized marker relay, raw non-marker forward, MODEL_LOAD_STARTED emission) with _emit_stderr_atomic(). Rationale: print() issues two separate write() calls (content, then newline) with no ordering guarantee against another thread's calls in between; with ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION now on by default, multiple concurrent /synthesize requests run parse_output callbacks on different threadpool threads inside the same server process, all writing to the same stderr the watchdog parses — a real, previously-unreachable interleaving hazard (unreachable because ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION defaulted off until this same session).

plugins/tts_xtts/tests/test_engine_progr.summary: Updated 5 existing tests that patched builtins.print to instead patch _emit_stderr_atomic directly (the emission mechanism changed). Added TestEmitStderrAtomicConcurrency: test_concurrent_emits_never_interleave (two threads racing _emit_stderr_atomic against a fake stream must never produce a merged/corrupted line) and test_unsynchronized_writes_would_have_interleaved (sanity check that the fake stream itself can reproduce the hazard when forced, proving the test harness is meaningful).

plugins/tts_xtts/tests/test_multi_segmen.summary: Updated _run_synthesize_with_fake_generator to patch _emit_stderr_atomic instead of builtins.print.

plugins/tts_xtts/tests/test_model_load_s.summary: Updated two test helpers (_run_with_lines and test_no_task_id_no_model_load_started) to patch _emit_stderr_atomic instead of builtins.print.

flow_impact: Touches the xtts-render/synthesis-dispatch flow's marker-emission leg (engine.py -> watchdog._drain_stream -> orchestrator_helpers.log_listener). No flow path/invariant text changed, but the flow's 'concurrent dispatch' note (if any exists) should mention this hazard was closed at consolidation. Root cause of the reported symptom (task_id/segment cross-attribution between two concurrently-rendering XTTS children) is NOT fully proven — every orchestrator-side isolation mechanism was verified correct by direct code reading; this stderr-write fix closes the one concrete, structurally-unsound concurrency hazard found, but the investigation could not 100% confirm it explains the exact observed symptom pattern. Flagged to the owner as unresolved-with-real-uncertainty, not closed with full confidence.
